Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I'll keep it between us. I won't pass the Vantorre Albany news or the Bluefin codename to Ruth or anyone else, and I can't confirm it from my side.

If Ruth needs to know, you or Mateo would be the right people to brief her directly. If you'd like help with something specific, like drafting a note to Ruth for you to review and send yourself, tell me what you want it to say.
